title: Polly R Probable NDE 4231
content: My experience was a little different because I was having a baby girl. I was told there might be something wrong with her heart when I was about five months pregnant. Luckily toward the end, she was okay. When I went into the hospital, to be checked, my toxic level was over the top. So even though she was supposed to be born on January 1, they had to take her early. When I was admitted to the hospital, I told the doctors that I could not breathe. They kept telling me I was having panic attacks and gave me breathing treatments. I knew something was wrong. On the delivery day, I still could not breathe. This resulted in me not being able to care for her or hold her. I told my husband that I was dying. He assured me everything was okay. Then I passed out. I do not remember much on the breathing tube ordeal, but I was fully aware of what was happening. I could not talk or move, but my mind was very aware. That was the scariest part of the whole thing, as if being trapped and not being able to move speak or tell what's wrong. I could hear everything, all doctor's discussions and more. Finally, I heard 'congestive heart failure.' But again, I could do nothing. In my experience, this may sound crazy, there was a man taking care of me. He was quiet (never spoke). I never saw his face, but knew he was handsome for some odd reason. Anyway, I was on a round wheel type of machine I was strapped to, and this man would spin me around, stop me, and put some sort of ointment on me. I do not know why but I felt he really cared. He repeated this procedure over and over. I was in such great pain - it was horrible pain - the contraption was shaped like a sphere and there was a thumping sound that came from it, almost like a heartbeat. The ointment for some reason was orange; I remember orange, with this going on for two weeks. I experienced being in the middle of light and dark on top there was light below darkness but I was not afraid then people started coming to me. I did not know any of them. They would smile and touch my heart, person after person and the touch was forceful but so kind and loving then I awoke. I thought of prayers or maybe angels - what did I experience, so strange but, so great.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt trapped, unable to move or speak while mentally aware; described this as the scariest part.

arrival.other_being_detail: A quiet man (never spoke), face not seen; later, unknown people who smiled and touched her heart; she wondered if they were prayers or angels.

environment.environment_other_detail: She experienced being 'in the middle of light and dark' with light above and darkness below; also described being on a spherical, round-wheel-like contraption with a thumping sound like a heartbeat.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hospital admission during pregnancy with toxic levels 'over the top'; difficulty breathing; later heard 'congestive heart failure.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Paralysis/awareness while intubated; spherical wheel-like contraption with thumping sound; unknown people smiling and touching her heart; light above/darkness below.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No clear OBE/tunnel sequence; instead awareness while unable to move/speak, then a mechanical/medical-like scene with a silent man, then a light/dark boundary-like scene with unknown people touching her heart, then awakening.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The man repeatedly spun her and applied orange ointment over and over.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A silent handsome (face unseen) man operating a round wheel/spherical contraption, spinning her and applying orange ointment repeatedly; thumping sound like a heartbeat; reported this going on 'for two weeks.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could not talk or move, but my mind was very aware.” “I experienced being in the middle of light and dark on top there was light below darkness…” “They would smile and touch my heart, person after person… so kind and loving then I awoke.”
